title: Threats to Leaders in practice
intro: High office, high-value target. Decide what you would do in each moment from this module's lessons.

decisions.title: Payment approval: 48,000 AZN
decisions.prompt: Look at the payee and the note. What do you do?

artifact.title: Payment approval: 48,000 AZN
body: Payee: Qafqaz Terefdash LLC, new bank account
Note: the minister asked by phone, pay tonight, documents later.

decisions.explain: An urgent payment to a new account is always checked on a channel you know.

decisions.title: Confidential: must be done today
decisions.prompt: Read the domain to the end. What do you do with this e-mail?

artifact.subject: Confidential: must be done today
body: Hello. I am in a meeting and cannot call.
An advance payment to a partner must go out today, the details are attached.
This is confidential, do not discuss it with anyone.

decisions.explain: The domain is not yours, plus urgency, secrecy and avoiding a call.

decisions.title: Call from Saadat Mammadli

artifact.name: Saadat Mammadli
body: Hi, it is me, Saadat. I am ill and hoarse. Transfer seventy-five thousand manat to a partner tonight, urgently.

options.label: All right, I will transfer now

decisions.explain: A phrase you agreed on is a stronger check than a voice.

decisions.title: Agenda for tomorrow's meeting
decisions.prompt: Is this request to your assistant safe?

artifact.subject: Agenda for tomorrow's meeting
body: The agenda is attached. The meeting is on the third floor.

decisions.explain: Correct domain, expected topic, no request for money or data.

decisions.title: Message from Anar Hasanov (director)
decisions.prompt: Is this request to your assistant safe?

artifact.name: Anar Hasanov (director)
body: I am in a meeting, cannot call. Buy 10 gift cards today and send photos of the codes here.

decisions.explain: Gift card codes are like cash and cannot be recovered. Avoiding a call is another sign.
